## Statute
§3306(c)(10)(A)(ii) - excludes from "employment" service performed by the spouse of a student enrolled at a school, college, or university.

## Reasoning
Section 3306(c)(10)(A)(ii) defines an exception to "employment" that applies only to service performed by the spouse of a student enrolled at a school, college, or university. In this case, Bob is Alice's father, not her spouse. The facts state that Alice was enrolled at Johns Hopkins University from August 29, 2015 to May 30, 2019, and Bob was paid $3,200 in 2017 for services performed for Johns Hopkins University. Since Bob is the father and not the spouse of the student, Section 3306(c)(10)(A)(ii) does not apply to Bob's employment situation. The claim that this section applies is therefore false.

## Answer
Answer: Contradiction
